sectionDescription: This is a review of the set of norms that we all agree on. They set the tone of the conversation and ensure that it is welcoming and constructive.

items.title: Be curious and listen.
content: Be open to others’ experiences and ready to learn from them. We are here to understand each other, not to change minds.

items.title: Be respectful and do not judge.
content: Set judgement aside and strive to make others feel respected and valued.

items.title: Seek common ground.
content: Look for shared values and areas of agreement, and embrace diverse views.

items.title: Embrace and welcome authenticity.
content: Share what is important to you and speak from experience.

items.title: Be purposeful and to the point.
content: Keep your comments concise and relevant.

items.title: ake responsibility for the conversation.
content: Be proactive about keeping the conversation on track, and respect the conversation agreements.
